selection_rule: Highest validation net benefit subject to minimum precision
limitations: All refund-abuse labels are simulated; metrics measure recovery of the simulator's patterns, not production performance.
False-positive cost and expected-loss fields are explicit assumptions and need merchant calibration.
Graph inputs are entity-reuse counts, not yet multi-hop or community features.
A flagged case means verify or review; it is not an automatic accusation or refund denial.
